sources.title: oakmindai/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-FTW · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Provenance Z.ai developed and published the original GLM-5.3 Flash model. Red Hat AI published the NVFP4 source checkpoint. Its routed-expert quantization was produced with LLM Compressor. FreeToken provides the native inference backend, FTW format and converter, KDA/DSA kernels, FP8 W8A16 projection kernel, and NVMe-MoE expert-bank runtime. Spark Lab provides the DGX Spark product experience ...

sources.title: GLM-5.3 | OpenLM.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3 is our latest flagship model for coding and long-horizon tasks. It marks a substantial leap in long-horizon task capability over its predecessor GLM-5.1 and delivers that capability on a solid 1M-token context. It is pure open with an MIT open-source license — no regional limits, technical access without borders.

sources.title: GLM-5-3-app/GLM-5.3: GLM-5.3, one click to install - GitHub
sources.snippet: What makes GLM-5.3 special for coding? It's the top-ranked open-weights coding model right now, with a 50% coding jump over GLM-5.2 from post-training alone — and on Z.AI's own Code Bench it's more accurate than Claude Opus 4.8 while using less than half the tokens per task.

sources.snippet: GLM-5.3 uses the same base model as GLM-5.2 — every gain comes from post-training. Compared with GLM-5.2, it is much better at complex coding and long-horizon tasks: Stronger Coding: GLM-5.3 is the most capable open-weights model for coding, with a 50% improvement over GLM-5.2 on our in-house Z.ai Code Bench.
